descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S18 「现成的 spec：Send 复用的 Handoff 发送和记录」 Existing specs: the Handoff delivery and record that Send reuses

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 The Handoff delivery that Send reuses: in-app only, to a signed-in valid account (never yourself, never an address), recorded with sender, recipient and timestamp, retrievable by both and by nobody e …（TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Two accounts (DEMO_USER, OTHER_USER) signed in through the API

When List recipients; send a handoff; read it as recipient and sender; try self, a non-account and empty text; read as a third party

Then Picker lists other accounts by id and name only, never the caller; the handoff reaches the recipient with sender name, is retrievable by both, audited; self / non-account / empty are refused; a third party cannot read it

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright API assertions. They pin the Handoff side of 'same delivery and record as Handoff'; they send a handoff, not a task list, so they are no evidence for U7/U8 (S16, S17)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
